home.heroTitle: Bringing Medication to China? Check Customs Legality in 3 Seconds
home.heroDesc: China enforces strict zero-tolerance drug laws. Foreign doctor prescriptions do NOT grant immunity for banned narcotics. Verify your medication, calculate legal carry days, and generate bilingual border declaration cards.
home.searchPlaceholder: Enter brand name, active ingredient or CAS number (e.g., Adderall, Xanax, Ozempic, 300-62-9)...
home.statusGridDesc: Customs inspection and legal allowance strictly depend on your medication's active ingredient.
home.catBannedDesc: Zero tolerance. Carrying these substances into China constitutes criminal drug smuggling under PRC Criminal Law Article 347. Foreign prescriptions provide zero legal immunity.
home.catControlledDesc: Allowed only with legitimate medical proof. Mandatory written declaration at customs Red Channel. Strictly limited to a single treatment course (7-15 days).
home.catAllowedDesc: Allowed for personal use up to reasonable travel duration (typically up to 90 days for chronic prescriptions in original pharmacy packaging). Green Channel clearance.
home.redLineAlertTitle: CRITICAL CRIMINAL WARNING: ZERO TOLERANCE FOR ILLICIT DRUGS
home.redLineAlertDesc: Substances like Adderall (Amphetamine) and CBD/THC cannabis extracts are classified as illegal narcotics under Chinese Criminal Law. Possession at the border triggers criminal detention or deportation.
home.toolBagDesc: Audit your complete baggage for cumulative precursor limits (Pseudoephedrine) and dangerous drug overlaps.
home.toolCalcDesc: Verify whether your 15, 30, or 90-day medication supply exceeds Chinese customs limits.
home.toolCardDesc: One-click printable dual-language summary for Chinese border inspection officers.
home.faqSectionTitle: Frequently Asked Questions About China Customs Medication Rules
home.faq1Q: Can I bring Adderall into China if I have an official doctor's note and prescription?
home.faq1A: No. Under PRC Criminal Law and the State Council Narcotic Catalogue, Amphetamine is strictly prohibited. Foreign prescriptions hold zero legal weight at Chinese customs.
home.faq2Q: What is the maximum supply of medication I can legally bring into China?
home.faq2A: Under GACC Notice 43, travelers may carry a reasonable quantity for personal use during their travel duration. For Category 1 psychotropics, maximum 7 days. For Category 2 psychotropics, maximum 15-30 days. For chronic maintenance drugs, up to 90 days.
home.faq3Q: Do I need to go through the Red Channel to declare ordinary blood pressure or diabetes medication?
home.faq3A: No. Ordinary non-controlled maintenance medications (hypertension, diabetes, asthma) within a reasonable 90-day personal supply can pass through the Green Channel without declaration.
home.faq4Q: Can I bring Ozempic or Wegovy pens on flights to China?
home.faq4A: Yes. GLP-1 medications are legal for personal use. However, you must keep them in carry-on baggage with portable cold packs, carry your prescription for the needles, and follow CAAC aviation safety rules.
home.faq5Q: What should I do if I run out of prescription medication while in China?
home.faq5A: You cannot have controlled medicines shipped via international courier. Visit a licensed Tier-3 public hospital or international clinic (e.g., United Family, Jiahui Health) with your foreign medical summary for an in-person refill.
